title: Frozen Phoenix — Master Data Field Type Registry
description: Centralized SSOT catalog of every canonical field type across the Frozen Phoenix platform. Each entry defines the base data type, validation rules, PII classification, encryption requirements, audit trail requirements, RLS scope, module usage, and RBAC tier assignment.

field_types.description: Primary key identifier for all entities. Generated server-side via gen_random_uuid().
Foreign key reference to another entity. Enforced via FK constraint with ON DELETE behavior.
Tenant isolation key. Every RLS policy filters on this field via get_user_org_id().
Reference to auth.users. Links entity to authenticated user identity.
URL-safe, human-readable identifier. Must be unique within scope.
Auto-generated sequential document number (e.g., PROP-2025-0001, INV-2025-0001).
Physical barcode/QR code identifier for scanning workflows.
Entity display name. Required, non-empty text field used across all modules.
Free-text description or notes field. Optional, supports full-text search.
Entity title. Typically required and displayed as primary label.
Free-form notes. May contain PII — flagged for review in compliance checks.
Structured rich text content stored as JSON (ProseMirror/TipTap format).
Email address field. Direct PII — requires masking for non-privileged roles.
Phone number. Direct PII — field masking applied for vendor/client roles.
Person's first/given name. Direct PII.
Person's last/family name. Direct PII.
Generated full name column. Read-only derived from first_name + last_name.
User-facing display name. May differ from legal name.
Preferred/nickname for the person.
Emergency contact information. Sensitive PII — encrypted at rest, access restricted to exec/pm.
IP address captured during authentication or signature events.
Tax identification number (EIN, TIN, VAT). Encrypted at rest, exec-only access.
Street address line (street1 or street2).
City/locality component of address.
State/province/region component.
Postal/zip code.
Country code or name. Defaults to USA.
Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) as PostgreSQL POINT type.
Standard monetary amount with 2 decimal places. Restricted to exec/pm roles.
Large monetary amount (up to 999,999,999,999.99). For budget totals and aggregates.
Hourly compensation rate. Financial PII — restricted to exec/pm/payroll roles.
Percentage value (0.00-100.00). Used for probability, discount, tax, markup, rollout.
ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).
Auto-computed variance (actual - estimated). Read-only generated column.
Auto-computed total cost from rate × hours. Read-only generated column.
Currency exchange rate with 6 decimal precision.
General ledger account code (e.g., 1000, 4100-01). Exec-only access.
Payment terms in days (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).
Calendar date without time component. Used for due dates, start/end dates, etc.
Timestamp with timezone. Used for event times, completions, approvals.
Immutable creation timestamp. Set once on INSERT, never modified.
Auto-updated modification timestamp via update_updated_at_column() trigger.
Time-of-day without date. Used for call times, start/end times, doors time.
IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London).
Status lifecycle field. Enforced via PostgreSQL ENUM or TEXT CHECK constraint. State transitions validated via triggers where applicable.
Classification/category field. Enforced via ENUM or CHECK constraint.
Priority level enum. Maps to task_priority ENUM type.
Incident severity classification.
Platform-level role assignment. Determines base permission tier.
Department classification for crew, tasks, and resources.
Generic boolean toggle. Used for is_active, is_default, is_shared, approval_required, etc.
Consent/privacy acceptance flag. Audit-logged for compliance.
Non-negative integer count. Used for quantities, capacities, counts, versions.
Decimal hours (e.g., 7.50). Used for time tracking and resource planning.
Completion percentage (0-100). Enforced via CHECK constraint.
1-5 star rating. Integer for testimonials, decimal for reviews.
Physical dimension measurement (width, depth, height, weight). Paired with unit field.
Inventory quantity with decimal support for fractional units.
Auto-computed lead score based on budget, completeness, source. Computed via calculate_lead_score().
Generic URL field for links, file references, avatar URLs, document URLs.
Reference to Supabase Storage object. May contain PII documents.
Flexible JSONB metadata. Used for activity_log metadata, config, custom data.
Schema-validated configuration JSONB. Should have JSON schema validation trigger.
Ordered array of structured objects (e.g., pipeline stages, SOP steps, line items).
Filter/sort/group configuration for views and reports.
Feature flag targeting rules (org IDs, roles, environments, user IDs, rollout %).
Array of text values. Used for tags, skills, deliverables, roles, etc.
Array of UUID references. Used for mentions, team_ids, vendor_ids, attachment_ids.
Array of integers. Used for reminder_minutes, etc.
Reference to the user who created the record.
Reference to the user who last modified the record.
Audit action type describing what operation was performed.
Immutable audit payload. PII sanitized via sanitize_audit_payload(). Exec-only access.
Sequential version number for versioned entities.
CRUD + business action types for permission grants.
Scope level at which a permission grant applies.
Access control decision (allow/deny/conditional) logged for audit.
Scope level for hierarchical settings with inheritance chain.
Setting value stored as JSONB. Validated against setting_definitions schema.
Unique snake_case identifier for a feature flag.
Type of feature flag evaluation (boolean on/off, percentage rollout, or A/B variant).
Hex color value (e.g., #FF5733). Used for branding, theming, visual identifiers.
Font family name for brand theming.
Workflow instance execution status.
Approval decision status. Audit-logged for compliance.
Event type that triggers an automation rule.
Type classification for compliance documents.
Expiration date with renewal alert threshold. Critical for compliance monitoring.
Data retention period in days. Enforced by retention policy engine.
Legal hold flag preventing deletion/modification. Exec-only control.
API idempotency key preventing duplicate operations.
Hashed token value. Never stored in plaintext.
Encrypted secret value. Access restricted to system and exec roles.
2D position on floor plan (x, y coordinates with optional rotation).
MIME type for file classification (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).
File size in bytes.
SHA-256 content hash for integrity verification and deduplication.
SLA target time in minutes (RTO/RPO/response time).
Dot-notation event type (e.g., project.status_changed, invoice.paid).
Immutable event payload containing the domain event data.
Environmental sensor reading (temperature, humidity, noise level, wind speed).
Crowd/occupancy count for safety monitoring.
